## 🎯 Next Steps

### Option 1: GitHub Pages (Recommended)
1. **Install Git**: Download from [git-scm.com](https://git-scm.com/downloads)
2. **Run deployment script**: Double-click `deploy.bat` or run `./deploy.ps1`
3. **Create GitHub repository**: Follow the script instructions
4. **Enable GitHub Pages**: Select "GitHub Actions" as source

### Option 2: Firebase Hosting
1. **Install Firebase CLI**: `npm install -g firebase-tools`
2. **Login**: `firebase login`
3. **Deploy**: `firebase deploy`

### Manual Deployment
1. Upload the `dist/` folder to any static hosting service
2. Configure the server for SPA routing
3. Ensure HTTPS is enabled

## 🔧 Production Checklist

### Before Going Live:
- [ ] Update Firebase configuration with your project details
- [ ] Set up Firebase Authentication authorized domains
- [ ] Configure Firestore security rules
- [ ] Configure Storage security rules
- [ ] Test all functionality on live site
- [ ] Add your live URL to README

### After Deployment:
- [ ] Test Google Sign-In functionality
- [ ] Verify image upload works
- [ ] Check responsive design on various devices
- [ ] Test item posting and claiming
- [ ] Monitor Firebase usage and costs
